source_roles.helper: Four option labels, generator-selected series/index/pipeline and initial system context remove free navigation; matching CT raw input is retained but no probe PNG.
source_roles.input: Controller injects task prompt + selected sidecar PNG into first user message. It does not attach the preprocessor payload metadata. System prompt may separately include initial viewport windowCenter/windowWidth and study context; no fresh run establishes exact realized hints.
source_roles.output: one option letter via submit_answer; no answer retained
source_roles.reference: Generator maps source modality/pipeline name to expected A/B/C/D letter; noise maps to D. This metadata rule is not clinical image adjudication. Actual generated task reference not bundled.
source_roles.scorer: same ABRA normalized exact_match_scorer, no task run
source_roles.oracle: No oracle tool for vision_probe: tool_registry exposes only submit_answer. query_birads_model and oracle_data belong to distinct BI-RADS tasks, not this probe.

task_contract.preselected_indices: n<=5: all indices; n>5: int((n/5)*i+n/10), i=0..4; series stack-normal order (fallback InstanceNumber), not ZIP order
task_contract.noise_implementation: Source name noise_gaussian; actual rng.integers(0,256,uint8), seed=42, ignores DICOM values, preserves dimensions, metadata={}. Not Gaussian or additive noise.

display_transformations.lung_window: rescale slope/intercept; C=-600 HU,W=1500 HU; clip [-1350,150]; scale/truncate uint8
display_transformations.soft_tissue_window: rescale slope/intercept; C=40 HU,W=400 HU; clip [-160,240]; scale/truncate uint8
display_transformations.breast_mri: optional non-default rescale; 1st–99th percentiles, flat-image fallback min/max then +1; no HU or enhancement label implied
display_transformations.modality_normal: default preprocessor; native modality comes from source series; MR and MRI share option B
